details:
Since you guys have removed mods, a few mods which would make amazing features would be:
**Camera animation:**
- For content creators
- Able to set pins to guide the camera (poorly explained) 
**Camera res change:**
- Self-explanatory
**screenshot manager:**
- Menu in the quick menu
- Allows you to preview, sort and delete screenshots/photos
**Immobilise player (Setting):**
- Freezing being able to move around
- Useful for controller drifting or accidental movement 
**Ask to portal (Setting):**
- Askes whether you want to go through the portal, leave, or blacklist the users portals
**Freeze frame:**
- This one is just personal, I don't like holding poses when taking photos so being able to make a local-only copy of you or anyone in the lobby…wouldn't really want this as an actual feature but ill suggest it anyway
**Join notifier (Setting):**
- When friends join you get a notification near your mic logo
**Instance history:**
- Also pretty Self-explanatory 
**Portable mirror:**
- A local mirror you can spawn
- Can change opacity 
- Different types (ceiling, solid, transparent, etc)
**Screenshots in loading screen (Setting):**
- Instead of safety tips, you can turn on a screenshot slideshow
**Comfy VR (QoL):**
- Pretty sure everyone knows this one 
**Better portal placements:**
- Being able to pick where you place the portal (obviously can't place near players nor spawn)
**vrc paste button:**
- Let us be able to paste links, names, etc via a button next to enter
**Remove chairs (Setting):**
- I hate accidentally clicking on chairs…
- Simply a setting you can toggle
**no grabby hands:**
- Similar to the one above it but with pickupable objects
**No outlines (Setting):**
- The feature I most want
- Simply put…no outlines, no text when hovering over something, no dotted lines
**Avatar Search:**
- I understand the problems with this one, but being able to joke around about being toast and then suddenly changing into toast is great
title: Mods I'd like to see be features
